<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pelican on a Bicycle</title>
<style>
  body {
    margin: 0;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(#87ceeb, #cfe8ff 60%, #a8d5a2);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  svg { max-width: 90vw; max-height: 90vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg viewBox="0 0 800 500" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Animated pelican riding a bicycle">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#87ceeb"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#e0f3ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="url(#sky)"/>

  <!-- sun -->
  <circle cx="120" cy="90" r="45" fill="#ffd166">
    <animate attributeName="r" values="45;50;45" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- drifting clouds -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0;700,0" dur="45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <ellipse cx="60" cy="70" rx="50" ry="18"/>
      <ellipse cx="90" cy="58" rx="40" ry="16"/>
      <ellipse cx="120" cy="70" rx="45" ry="15"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-200,0;600,0" dur="60s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <ellipse cx="40" cy="150" rx="40" ry="14"/>
      <ellipse cx="65" cy="140" rx="30" ry="12"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="430" width="800" height="70" fill="#6b9e4f"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="430" x2="800" y2="430" stroke="#4e7a38" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- whole bike + pelican group, bobbing gently -->
  <g transform="translate(0,0)">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0;0,-8;0,0" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- rear wheel -->
    <g transform="translate(250,395)">
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <circle r="55" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="6"/>
        <circle r="6" fill="#333"/>
        <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="3">
          <line x1="0" y1="-55" x2="0" y2="55"/>
          <line x1="-55" y1="0" x2="55" y2="0"/>
          <line x1="-39" y1="-39" x2="39" y2="39"/>
          <line x1="39" y1="-39" x2="-39" y2="39"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- front wheel -->
    <g transform="translate(520,395)">
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <circle r="55" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="6"/>
        <circle r="6" fill="#333"/>
        <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="3">
          <line x1="0" y1="-55" x2="0" y2="55"/>
          <line x1="-55" y1="0" x2="55" y2="0"/>
          <line x1="-39" y1="-39" x2="39" y2="39"/>
          <line x1="39" y1="-39" x2="-39" y2="39"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- frame -->
    <g stroke="#c0392b" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="250" y1="395" x2="380" y2="300"/>
      <line x1="380" y1="300" x2="520" y2="395"/>
      <line x1="250" y1="395" x2="380" y2="395"/>
      <line x1="380" y1="300" x2="380" y2="395"/>
      <line x1="380" y1="300" x2="340" y2="245"/>
      <line x1="340" y1="245" x2="250" y2="395"/>
    </g>

    <!-- seat -->
    <ellipse cx="340" cy="240" rx="22" ry="8" fill="#333"/>

    <!-- handlebar -->
    <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="340" y1="245" x2="360" y2="225"/>
      <line x1="360" y1="225" x2="390" y2="225"/>
    </g>

    <!-- crank + pedals -->
    <g transform="translate(380,395)">
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <circle r="8" fill="#333"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="-40" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="40" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
        <rect x="-8" y="-44" width="16" height="8" rx="3" fill="#555"/>
        <rect x="-8" y="36" width="16" height="8" rx="3" fill="#555"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- pelican body (sits above seat) -->
    <g>
      <!-- tail -->
      <ellipse cx="260" cy="225" rx="34" ry="14" fill="#f5f0e6" transform="rotate(-20 260 225)"/>

      <!-- body -->
      <ellipse cx="340" cy="215" rx="85" ry="55" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e8e2d4" stroke-width="2"/>

      <!-- wing, flapping -->
      <g transform="translate(300,205)">
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-15,300,205;15,300,205;-15,300,205" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <path d="M0,0 C -40,-30 -80,-40 -110,-25 C -80,-10 -45,-5 0,10 Z" fill="#eae4d6" stroke="#d8d0bd" stroke-width="2"/>
        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- neck -->
      <path d="M390,200 C 420,160 440,120 455,95" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="26" stroke-linecap="round"/>

      <!-- head -->
      <circle cx="460" cy="80" r="26" fill="#ffffff"/>

      <!-- eye -->
      <circle cx="470" cy="74" r="5" fill="#222"/>

      <!-- beak (top) -->
      <path d="M482,82 C 520,72 560,60 585,55 C 575,52 560,52 545,55 C 530,60 510,70 492,84 Z" fill="#f4a300" stroke="#d98b00" stroke-width="2"/>

      <!-- pouch (bottom) -->
      <path d="M484,86 C 510,92 545,95 570,92 C 545,105 510,105 484,86 Z" fill="#f9c74f" stroke="#e6a200" stroke-width="2">
        <animate attributeName="d"
          values="M484,86 C 510,92 545,95 570,92 C 545,105 510,105 484,86 Z;
                  M484,86 C 510,100 545,108 570,104 C 545,120 510,118 484,86 Z;
                  M484,86 C 510,92 545,95 570,92 C 545,105 510,105 484,86 Z"
          dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>

      <!-- legs pedaling (attached near crank) -->
      <g>
        <!-- back leg -->
        <g stroke="#f4a300" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
          <line x1="345" y1="235" x2="375" y2="360">
            <animate attributeName="y2" values="360;355;360" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <animate attributeName="x2" values="375;380;375" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          </line>
        </g>
        <!-- front leg -->
        <g stroke="#f4a300" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
          <line x1="350" y1="235" x2="388" y2="390">
            <animate attributeName="y2" values="390;385;390" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <animate attributeName="x2" values="388;392;388" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          </line>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- moving ground dashes to suggest travel -->
  <g stroke="#4e7a38" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="800,0;0,0" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <line x1="50"  y1="455" x2="90"  y2="455"/>
      <line x1="150" y1="455" x2="190" y2="455"/>
      <line x1="250" y1="455" x2="290" y2="455"/>
      <line x1="350" y1="455" x2="390" y2="455"/>
      <line x1="450" y1="455" x2="490" y2="455"/>
      <line x1="550" y1="455" x2="590" y2="455"/>
      <line x1="650" y1="455" x2="690" y2="455"/>
      <line x1="750" y1="455" x2="790" y2="455"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
</body>
</html>
